# AL1302: Avoid lock on typeof(T)

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Threading` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1300ToAl1303ThreadingAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Type objects obtained from typeof() are globally visible singletons. Any code can obtain the same Type object and lock on it, potentially causing deadlocks. Use a private static readonly object field instead.
